newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast prods flat in dull pre-weekend trade.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast prods flat in dull pre-weekend trade.

text.p: U.S. West Coast bulk product prices were flat Friday trade with activity quiet as traders squared their books or left early for the weekend, brokers said.
A relatively quiet NYMEX also kept the market in check, with February crude up eight cents at $25.60 a barrel and gasoline off 0.92 cent a gallon to 69 cents.
January shipments of diesel fuels were nearly finished, brokers said, with only a few days of left for CARB gasoline.
Los Angeles CARB gasoline ranged 75/76 cents a gallon, flat from late Thursday levels, traders said.
Conventional grade gasoline stayed at 74/75 cents a gallon.
Trades focused on February barrels of CARB diesel, which stood 75.25/76.25 cents, about a penny over yesterday's January barrels.
